business_summary.text: Shakti Pumps is a leading manufacturer of solar water pumps and related products, with a focus on the renewable energy sector. The company is expanding into adjacent businesses including solar rooftop systems, EV motors, and backward integration into solar modules and cells.

lab.quote: In this quarter, we installed 23,865 solar pumps, which is a major feat for our company. Compared to the same quarter of previous year, we have achieved approximately 7% growth in the number of installations.

call_memory.quote: In this quarter, we installed 23,865 solar pumps, which is a major feat for our company. Compared to the same quarter of previous year, we have achieved approximately 7% growth in the number of installations.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Shakti Pumps installed 23,865 solar pumps in Q2 FY27, achieving approximately 7% growth compared to the same quarter of the previous year.

lab.quote: In addition, we recorded approximately 70% growth across rooftop, solar domestic and industrial business, reflecting positive momentum in business diversification and supporting our future growth prospects.

call_memory.quote: In addition, we recorded approximately 70% growth across rooftop, solar domestic and industrial business, reflecting positive momentum in business diversification and supporting our future growth prospects.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company recorded approximately 70% growth across rooftop, solar domestic, and industrial businesses in Q2 FY27.

call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company was utilizing approximately 68% of pump and motor capacity in the first half of the year.

lab.quote: So, in this quarter, compared to the same quarter last year, we had a good 58% growth in the revenue.

call_memory.quote: So, in this quarter, compared to the same quarter last year, we had a good 58% growth in the revenue.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Rooftop revenue grew 58% in Q2 FY27 compared to the same quarter last year.

lab.quote: Our margins depend on selling prices and raw material costs, which increased by approximately 3% quarter on quarter. However, our initiatives to manage expenses such as advertising expense optimisation, Kaizen initiatives, and tighter cost management, helped us reduce costs by 2%, limiting the net impact on EBITDA to only 1%.

call_memory.quote: Our margins depend on selling prices and raw material costs, which increased by approximately 3% quarter on quarter. However, our initiatives to manage expenses such as advertising expense optimisation, Kaizen initiatives, and tighter cost management, helped us reduce costs by 2%, limiting the net impact on EBITDA to only 1%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Raw material costs increased by approximately 3% quarter on quarter, but cost optimisation efforts reduced costs by 2%, limiting the net impact on EBITDA to 1%.

lab.quote: We expect commercial production to commence within the next one to one-and-a-half months, after which the output will be integrated into our operations.

call_memory.quote: We expect commercial production to commence within the next one to one-and-a-half months, after which the output will be integrated into our operations.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Commercial production at the 500 MW solar panel facility is expected to commence within the next one to one-and-a-half months.

lab.quote: The conflict around the Strait of Hormuz has led to a renewed increase in raw material costs. There was no expectation at all that MS, steel, and copper prices would increase in this quarter, yet they did increase.

call_memory.quote: The conflict around the Strait of Hormuz has led to a renewed increase in raw material costs. There was no expectation at all that MS, steel, and copper prices would increase in this quarter, yet they did increase.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Conflict around the Strait of Hormuz led to an unexpected increase in MS, steel, and copper raw material costs during the quarter.

lab.quote: We did around INR543 crores in solar EPC, which corresponds to 23,865 units. Apart from this, we did around INR95 crores in exports. And combining domestic, industrial, and other segments, it was approximately INR40 crores.

call_memory.quote: We did around INR543 crores in solar EPC, which corresponds to 23,865 units. Apart from this, we did around INR95 crores in exports. And combining domestic, industrial, and other segments, it was approximately INR40 crores.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: In Q2 FY27, solar EPC revenue was around INR 543 crores for 23,865 units, exports were INR 95 crores, and domestic, industrial, and other segments were approximately INR 40 crores.

lab.quote: And in H1FY27, Solar EPC was around INR1,230 crores. And our export sales were INR177 crores, which includes Uganda project sales.

call_memory.quote: And in H1FY27, Solar EPC was around INR1,230 crores. And our export sales were INR177 crores, which includes Uganda project sales.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: In H1 FY27, solar EPC revenue was around INR 1,230 crores and export sales were INR 177 crores including Uganda project sales.

lab.quote: Regarding debt, sir, it was INR830 crores. The collections of around INR400 crores we had expected to receive at the end of Q2, were received in October instead. Therefore, you might be seeing that being reflected in the cash flow as well as in debt. That has already been corrected; currently, we are at less than INR500 crores approx. And going forward, we expect it to further decline by March end.

call_memory.quote: Regarding debt, sir, it was INR830 crores. The collections of around INR400 crores we had expected to receive at the end of Q2, were received in October instead. Therefore, you might be seeing that being reflected in the cash flow as well as in debt. That has already been corrected; currently, we are at less than INR500 crores approx. And going forward, we expect it to further decline by March end.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Debt reached INR 830 crores at the end of Q2 FY27 due to delayed collections, but reduced to less than INR 500 crores in October and is expected to decline further by March end.

lab.quote: The 2.2 GW facility is scheduled for completion in FY28, with strong revenue contributions expected after March 2028.

call_memory.quote: The 2.2 GW facility is scheduled for completion in FY28, with strong revenue contributions expected after March 2028.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The 2.2 GW solar cell facility is scheduled for completion in FY28, with strong revenue contributions expected after March 2028.

lab.quote: Our total capex plan is INR1,700 crores. Of this, approximately INR200 crores have been spent so far on the 2.2 GW solar cell plant.

call_memory.quote: Our total capex plan is INR1,700 crores. Of this, approximately INR200 crores have been spent so far on the 2.2 GW solar cell plant.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Total capex plan is INR 1,700 crores, of which approximately INR 200 crores has been spent so far on the 2.2 GW solar cell plant.

lab.quote: A tender for 100,000 pumps has also been issued for the subsequent quarter, from which we expect to secure more orders.

call_memory.quote: A tender for 100,000 pumps has also been issued for the subsequent quarter, from which we expect to secure more orders.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: A tender for 100,000 pumps has been issued under the Maharashtra Government's Magel Tyala scheme for the subsequent quarter.

lab.quote: In this tender, our allocation of 25,000 pumps was limited by an Asian Development Bank condition that caps any single bidder’s share at 25%.

call_memory.quote: In this tender, our allocation of 25,000 pumps was limited by an Asian Development Bank condition that caps any single bidder’s share at 25%.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: In the Magel Tyala market-mode tender, Shakti Pumps' allocation was capped at 25,000 pumps due to an Asian Development Bank condition capping any single bidder's share at 25%.

lab.quote: There was an impact of approximately 1% due to the sales mix.

call_memory.quote: There was an impact of approximately 1% due to the sales mix.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Sales realization saw an impact of approximately 1% due to the sales mix in Q2 FY27.

lab.quote: Our average interest cost is around 7%, supported by our AA- credit rating, which enables us to secure favorable borrowing rates.

call_memory.quote: Our average interest cost is around 7%, supported by our AA- credit rating, which enables us to secure favorable borrowing rates.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The company's average interest cost is around 7%, supported by its AA- credit rating.

lab.quote: They have already written to India Exim Bank for funding the second phase. We are pursuing that, and within that, we can supply the complete solar package.

call_memory.quote: They have already written to India Exim Bank for funding the second phase. We are pursuing that, and within that, we can supply the complete solar package.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The Ministry and Government of Uganda have written to India Exim Bank for funding the second phase of their project.

lab.quote: The order book we have needs to be completed within 90 days, and we are confident of executing it within that timeframe.

call_memory.quote: The order book we have needs to be completed within 90 days, and we are confident of executing it within that timeframe.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: The existing order book needs to be completed within 90 days.

lab.quote: As soon as we entered, our market share reached around 40%, even though we entered quite late. Farmers there have witnessed our performance, and we have installed approximately 12,000 pumps there.

call_memory.quote: As soon as we entered, our market share reached around 40%, even though we entered quite late. Farmers there have witnessed our performance, and we have installed approximately 12,000 pumps there.
call_memory.speaker: MANAGEMENT
call_memory.statement: Shakti Pumps achieved around 40% market share in Karnataka under the state scheme, installing approximately 12,000 pumps.

timeline.summary: Shakti Pumps invested ₹7 Cr in its subsidiary Shakti Energy Solutions on April 18, 2026, for a 2.20 GW solar module plant in Pithampur.
Shakti Pumps invested ₹10 Cr in its EV subsidiary Shakti EV Mobility on April 21, 2026, taking total investment to ₹65 Cr.
Received Letter of Empanelment from MSEDCL for 6,580 solar pumps worth ₹142.55 Cr (₹155.24 Cr with GST).

Shakti Pumps (India) Limited’s **Ravi Patidar** schedules Q4-FY2026 earnings conference call on **May 11, 2026, at 14:00 IST** for audited results ending **March 31, 2026** with **Dinesh Patidar, Ramesh Patidar, Ramakrishna Sataluri, Dinesh Patel**, and **Ravi Patidar** attending.
Shakti Pumps (India) Limited’s Board recommended ₹1 final dividend per equity share (10%) for FY2026, subject to AGM approval, with record date July 29, 2026.
Shakti Pumps filed Q4FY26 Monitoring Agency Reports showing ₹214.83 crore of unutilised QIP proceeds across two issues.
Shakti Pumps (India) Limited’s **Ravi Patidar** shared the conference call recording for audited Q4FY26 and FY26 results on May 11, 2026, at 14:00 IST via the company’s website.

Shakti Pumps' Q4FY26 earnings call: management guided KUSUM 2.0 orders from Q2FY27, ₹1,500 Cr order book execution over two quarters, and 0.5 GW module plant commissioning by end-Q1FY27, but gave no FY27 revenue or margin guidance.
Dinesh Patidar, as promoter of Shakti Pumps (India) Limited, declared holding 62,135,796 equity shares on March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances.
Q1FY27 earnings call held on 27 July 2026, with revenue growing 37.9% YoY to ₹859 Cr and EBITDA margin stable at 9.6%
Shakti Pumps (India) Limited’s **Ravi Patidar** announced a Q2 & H1 FY27 earnings conference call on **October 26, 2026, at 14:00 IST** for unaudited results.
On 22 October 2026, Shakti Pumps announced an investment of ₹12 Cr in its wholly owned subsidiary Shakti EV Mobility Private Limited, raising total consolidated investment to ₹92 Cr.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹746.03 Cr (+12.0% YoY), net profit ₹38.51 Cr (-57.5% YoY).
Shakti Pumps released its Q2 & H1 FY27 investor presentation highlighting a revenue of ₹746 Cr and an order book of ₹751 Cr.
Shakti Pumps held its Q2FY27 earnings call, highlighting trial runs at its 500 MW panel plant, expected PM-KUSUM 2.0 launch, and post-Q2 debt reduction to under ₹500 Cr.
